plugins.name: task-poke
plugins.description: Submits a continue prompt when a main-loop turn ends while the TodoWrite or Task tools list still has unfinished tasks, at most 5 times in a row. Reach L2: one $.prompt.submit per turn, reads the transcript, stores one boolean.
